patents.title: Example layout only — not a real patent
patents.original_idea: This card shows how each analyzed patent will look. Real entries will appear here after the first batch of data is analyzed.
patents.why_it_stalled: What was missing or too expensive back then (e.g. sensors, batteries, cheap solar, phones, AI).
patents.what_changed: Which modern technology now fills that gap, and what it costs today.
patents.product_idea: A concrete product someone could build today, aimed at underprivileged users.

patents.build_cost: Rough cost to build a first prototype.
patents.risks: Newer patents that might block it, regulation, distribution challenges.
